svg.title: Public-native target-wise SRE(ddof=0) comparison
svg.desc: Point estimates for all 22 candidate identities, faceted by target. SRE(ddof=0) is lower-is-better; no uncertainty intervals are shown.
svg.text: SRE(ddof=0); unitless; lower-is-better. Candidate rows are ordered by the frozen target-wise rank.
These are point estimates from the frozen RES-283 table; exact values and rights fields are in public-native-target-wise-rankings.csv.
